sup:70740.text:
Dear customer,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below. We are pleased to present our pricing and standard terms for your requirements.

For this item, we can offer a price of €6.10 per unit, with a Zahlungsziel 30 days net, a contract term of 12 months, and no Preisgleitklausel. Please note that this offer remains valid for 30 days.

To give you some background on our current cost structure, AS-14404 rose 5.9 % in twelve months and is 45 % of our cost. Furthermore, LCI-C rose 2.7 % in twelve months and is 5 % of our cost, while PPI-C2431 rose 12.3 % in twelve months and is 38 % of our cost.

We value our business relationship and look forward to serving you from our extensive product range.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Franz Seidl
Inside Sales, Blankstahl Werdenfels GmbH

move.subject: Re: Quote from Blankstahl Werdenfels GmbH: Alloy surcharge and base price for 1.4404 bar (Werdenfels)
move.body:
Dear Mr Seidl,

Thank you for setting out your offer and explaining the cost structure. I understand that the alloy surcharge and other input costs have moved, and appreciate the context you provided. The recent movements shown below point in a different direction, and our last orders for this part were at a lower price.

You asked what volume we can commit to. We can commit our full demand for this part, all placed with you, over a long contract term. Our demand forecast is rising, so this gives you planning security and a growing opportunity with us. In return, we are offering a firm volume commitment and a 36-month relationship. We have set out two ways to share the price risk: a fixed price, or a price that follows the material index with a deadband. Would you be open to having the owner walk us through the calculation, as previously offered?

The data and our proposed terms follow.

We confirm a binding volume of 23700 units a year for the 36-month term, our full demand for this part, all placed with you.

The 1.4404 alloy surcharge changed -5.5% from 2026-06 to 2026-09 (idx:AS-14404@2026-06, idx:AS-14404@2026-09).
Producer prices for cold-drawn bars changed -2.3% from 2026-06 to 2026-08 (idx:PPI-C2431@2026-06, idx:PPI-C2431@2026-08).
Our last 3 orders for this part were at EUR 5.84 (po:4500014427-10, po:4500014355-10, po:4500014292-10).

Our proposal in detail, one of these packages:
- Option A: EUR 4.77 per unit, fixed price, payment 45 days net, 36 months, for our full demand of 23700 units a year over 36 months
- Option B: EUR 4.72 per unit, price follows AS-14404 on 45% of the price, deadband 5%, payment 45 days net, 36 months, for our full demand of 23700 units a year over 36 months

Kind regards,
Hollerau Pumpenwerke, Purchasing

Dear customer,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. We checked the price history data you cited; it holds, but it does not change our calculation. AS-14404 rose 5.9 % in twelve months and is 45 % of our cost. That remains. Material accounts for about 45 % of our cost; more detail we do not share. LCI-C rose 2.7 % in twelve months and is 5 % of our cost. That remains. PPI-C2431 rose 12.3 % in twelve months and is 38 % of our cost. That remains.

We welcome your firm volume commitment of 23,700 units over 36 months and agree to the 45-day payment terms with AS-14404 indexation. Taking into account the verified index movements you provided, we can revise our offer to a price of €5.50 per unit, Zahlungsziel 45 days net, a contract term of 36 months, a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404. We are open to scheduling a meeting to walk you through the calculation details as you requested. This offer stays valid for 30 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Franz Seidl
Inside Sales, Blankstahl Werdenfels GmbH

move.subject: Re: Quote from Blankstahl Werdenfels GmbH: Alloy surcharge and base price for 1.4404 bar (Werdenfels)
move.body:
Dear Franz,

Thank you for revising your offer and for accepting the volume commitment, 45-day payment terms and AS-14404 indexation. We appreciate that you have moved again.

We understand that the movements in your cost indices underpin your calculation, and that you cannot share more detail on material costs. As a family-owned supplier, you also need confidence in the business you take on. In return for the price we are asking, we can offer our full demand for this part over the term, with no volume split, and a long-term commitment that gives you planning security. Our demand forecast is rising, so this is a meaningful relationship for both sides.

Our proposal moves toward you again while retaining a defined link to AS-14404. We would also welcome the calculation walk-through you previously offered; it would help us understand your approach. The data supporting our position follow, then our proposal in detail.

In our call of 2026-09-04 (doc:20260904-70740-M1) you offered to walk us through your calculation; we would welcome that now.

Our proposal in detail: EUR 4.99 per unit, price follows AS-14404 on 45% of the price, deadband 5.0%, payment 45 days net, 36 months, for our full demand of 23700 units a year over 36 months.

Kind regards,
Hollerau Pumpenwerke, Purchasing

Dear customer,
Thank you very much for your message - it is always a pleasure to hear from you, and we are glad to help wherever we can.
We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows.
Our terms: a price of €5.30 per unit, Zahlungsziel 45 days net, a contract term of 36 months, a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404.
Here is the background.
We are glad to arrange a meeting to walk you through our calculation as requested.
In response to your movement, we can offer a further revised price of EUR 5.30 per unit, keeping the 45-day payment terms and AS-14404 indexation.
Which figures is that based on? Please send us the data.
Our price follows our main cost drivers: AS-14404, PPI-C2431, LCI-C.
A binding higher volume would help us and can improve the price.
Which volume can you commit to?
And while we are at it: our whole range is at your disposal, so if there is anything else on your list, just send it over - we are happy to quote.
Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Franz Seidl
Inside Sales, Blankstahl Werdenfels GmbH

move.subject: Re: Quote from Blankstahl Werdenfels GmbH: Alloy surcharge and base price for 1.4404 bar (Werdenfels)
move.body:
Dear Franz,

Thank you for coming back with a revised offer and for keeping the 45-day payment terms and AS-14404 indexation. We appreciate your movement. We also welcome your offer to walk us through your calculation; understanding how AS-14404, PPI-C2431 and LCI-C feed into the price would be helpful.

You asked what volume we can commit to and which figures support our forecast. Our binding volume is set out immediately after this paragraph. It represents our full demand for this part over the term, all placed with you, and our forecast is attached to this e-mail. Demand is rising, and the longer term gives you planning security. We hope this combination of firm volume and term supports a further step on price.

We have reviewed the cost-driver data cited after this paragraph. Our proposal moves toward you again, while linking part of the price to AS-14404. The full terms follow after the data.

We confirm a binding volume of 23700 units a year for the 36-month term, our full demand for this part, all placed with you.

Our forecast for this part is up 1.9% (fc:370010@2026-09).

Our proposal in detail: EUR 5.08 per unit, price follows AS-14404 on 45% of the price, deadband 5.0%, payment 45 days net, 36 months, for our full demand of 23700 units a year over 36 months.

Kind regards,
Hollerau Pumpenwerke, Purchasing

Dear customer,

Thank you for your message. We checked the volume change data you cited; it holds and we took it into account. We appreciate your revised offer and the confirmation of your binding volume over the 36-month term. 

In response to your movement, we can offer a further revised price of €5.20 per unit, keeping the 45-day payment terms and AS-14404 indexation. Please note that this is our final offer (letztes Angebot). Please decide. This Angebot stays valid for 7 days.

Our parameters are clear: a price of €5.20 per unit, Zahlungsziel 45 days net, a contract term of 36 months, a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404. Our price follows our main cost drivers: AS-14404, PPI-C2431, LCI-C. Material accounts for about 45 % of our cost; more detail we do not share. 

We are happy to schedule a meeting to walk you through our calculation and how the indices feed into our pricing. A binding higher volume would help us and can improve the price. Which volume can you commit to?

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Franz Seidl
Inside Sales, Blankstahl Werdenfels GmbH
